architecture: The pipeline follows a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architecture: preprocessing → chunking → embedding → vector store indexing → retrieval → answer generation. Articles are loaded and chunked, embedded using OpenAI, indexed in FAISS, and retrieved using hybrid (vector + BM25) search. Retrieved chunks are passed to an LLM for answer generation.

design_decisions.chunking_strategy: Semantic chunking with overlap to preserve context and improve retrieval accuracy.
design_decisions.vector_store_selection: FAISS selected for fast, scalable similarity search and local resource efficiency.
design_decisions.embedding_model_choice: OpenAI text-embedding-3-small for high-quality, cost-effective embeddings.
design_decisions.retrieval_approach: Hybrid retrieval (vector + BM25) with reciprocal rank fusion for robust recall and precision.
design_decisions.batched_embedding_generation: Embeddings are generated in batches to optimize API usage and reduce latency.
design_decisions.cost_optimization: Batching, confidence thresholds, and top-K filtering reduce API calls and LLM usage. Only top relevant chunks are sent to the LLM.

api_usage_and_cost_analysis.cost_estimate: Embedding cost is minimized by batching. LLM cost is controlled by limiting context size and chunk count. Typical run: < $1 for 50 questions.
api_usage_and_cost_analysis.optimization_strategies: Batching, top-K filtering, confidence threshold, hybrid retrieval to minimize unnecessary API calls.

tradeoffs.accuracy_vs_speed_vs_cost: Hybrid retrieval increases accuracy but adds compute. Semantic chunking improves answer quality but increases embedding cost. Top-K and confidence threshold balance cost and recall.

limitations: LLM answers may not always match sample output verbatim.
Retrieval may miss relevant context if chunking is imperfect.
API rate limits and quota may affect large-scale runs.
No support for video demo generation.
future_improvements: Fine-tune chunking and retrieval for better sample output matching.
Add support for more embedding providers and vector stores.
Implement caching for embeddings and retrieval results.
Add UI for visualizing retrieval traces and matched text.
